cashWeek.label: Cash coming in
cashWeek.prompt: Today is {{today}}. Using ar_invoices_upcoming and ar_collections_daily, what cash is expected in the next 14 days by due date, and how does it compare with what was collected in the last 14?

coverageGaps.label: Why trucks sat idle
coverageGaps.prompt: Using dispatch_analytics_utilization_gap_reasons for this month, what were the top reasons driver-days went uncovered, and what would close the biggest gap?

dispatchToday.label: Today's dispatch picture
dispatchToday.prompt: Today is {{today}}. Give me today's dispatch picture from the dispatch_analytics_summary and shipment_pipeline_upcoming charts: scheduled pickups and deliveries today and tomorrow, loads by status, and coverage gaps. Use only those two charts — do not look loads or drivers up one by one.

driverLookup.label: Check a driver
driverLookup.prompt: Today is {{today}}. I'll name a driver — give me their headline numbers for the last 30 days (get_driver_overview) and their weekly earnings against the company's (driver_weekly_earnings).

driversAvailable.label: Available drivers
driversAvailable.prompt: List the drivers who are available right now (list_available_drivers, status available) with their phone numbers. One tool call, no per-driver look-ups.

emailSearch.label: Find an email
emailSearch.prompt: I'll describe an email — find it in my inbox (search_emails), summarize what it asks, and say whether it needs a reply.

expensesMonth.label: Track expenses
expensesMonth.prompt: Today is {{today}}. Break down this month's expenses by category from company_operating_pnl_summary and maintenance_cost_by_truck; flag the biggest line and anything unassigned to a truck (unassigned_expenses).

finances30d.label: Analyze my finances
finances30d.prompt: Today is {{today}}. Analyze my company's finances for the last 30 days: get_company_overview (period last_30_days) and the company_operating_pnl_summary chart — revenue, expenses and margin, in plain words.

fleetWeek.label: Fleet performance
fleetWeek.prompt: Today is {{today}}. How is the fleet doing this week? Use fleet_utilization_by_truck (truck_scope active) and fleet_truck_pnl: idle vs driving time, fuel waste, per-truck profit, and what dropped against last week.

fuelSpend.label: Fuel spend
fuelSpend.prompt: Today is {{today}}. Break down fuel spend for this month: company_fuel_spend_daily for the trend and fuel_by_state for where it was bought; point out the outliers.

insights.label: Business insights
insights.prompt: Today is {{today}}. Give me the key business insights from the last 30 days: get_company_overview, company_profitability_trend (date_basis delivery) and top_customers_by_revenue_detail — three calls, then the three things I should act on.

invoicesOverdue.label: Review invoices
invoicesOverdue.prompt: Review open invoices with the ar_invoice_aging chart: how much is past due in each bucket, which customers owe the most (customer_revenue_share for context), and what to chase first.

knowledge.label: Ask the knowledge base
knowledge.prompt: I'll ask a question — answer it from the company knowledge base (search_knowledge) and say which document the answer came from.

loadLookup.label: Look up a load
loadLookup.prompt: I'll give you a load number — show its status, rate, commodity, broker and stops (get_load_details), then tell me what has to happen next on it.

loadsByStatus.label: Loads by status
loadsByStatus.prompt: Today is {{today}}. Show the current load mix by status (load_status_distribution for this month, date_basis pickup) and the loads funnel (dispatch_operations_loads). Two chart calls, then a short read-out.

maintenanceSpend.label: Maintenance by truck
maintenanceSpend.prompt: Today is {{today}}. Using maintenance_cost_by_truck for this quarter, which trucks cost the most in work orders, and which of them look like a replacement case?

payrollPeriod.label: Driver pay this period
payrollPeriod.prompt: Today is {{today}}. Using driver_pnl_summary and reserve_by_driver for this pay period, show each driver's settlement P&L and broker pay vs driver pay, and point out the outliers.

pipelineWeek.label: Upcoming pickups & deliveries
pipelineWeek.prompt: Today is {{today}}. Using the shipment_pipeline_upcoming chart, list the scheduled pickups and deliveries per day for the next 7 days and point out the heavy days. One chart call.

recruitingCalls.label: Recruiting calls
recruitingCalls.prompt: How is recruiting going? Use recruiter_call_frequency and recruiter_call_score_summary: calls per recruiter, candidates reached, call quality, and who needs attention.

routeEstimate.label: Estimate a route
routeEstimate.prompt: Today is {{today}}. I'll name an origin and a destination — estimate the driving distance and ETA (get_route_estimate), then say what rate the trip would need to match our recent rate per mile (daily_rpm_gross_trend, date_basis pickup, last 30 days).

safetyCosts.label: Safety costs
safetyCosts.prompt: Today is {{today}}. Using safety_cost_by_month for the last 6 months, how have claims and inspection costs moved, and which month stands out and why?

truckLookup.label: Check a truck
truckLookup.prompt: Today is {{today}}. I'll name a truck — give me its headline numbers for the last 30 days (get_vehicle_overview) and its miles per day (truck_daily_miles).
